The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] once dwelt in a '''fortress''' located in the [[Naos Asteroid Belt]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It was later discovered by archaeologists during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who breached the fortress's vaults.<ref name="Mission" />
